g.text: Restaurant Rush - Stage 3 class diagram (tag stage-3, final design)
+readInt(prompt : String, min : int, max : int) : int
+showEndOfTurn(turn : int, maxTurns : int, r : Restaurant) : void
+showResult(victory : boolean, r : Restaurant, lines : String[]) : void
+takeOrder(c : Customer, m : Menu, hh : HappyHour) : Order
Every subclass must go through them, so no staff member
can do two tasks in one turn, and a failed (invalid)
action never uses up the task.
and chooseItem() are overridden by the subclasses.
call them on a Customer reference - no instanceof
from two existing MenuItems (price = 90% of sum, prep =
sum of units). Order, Chef and ConsoleUI treat it exactly
like a single dish, so none of them changed in Stage 3.
: Restaurant creates and owns its Tables,
Menu and HappyHour; they live and die with it.
Changes: Customer (+COMBO_SATISFACTION, recover(), combo rule in chooseItem),
Waiter (takeOrder now takes HappyHour), GameController (+host, happyHourStep(), hostStep()),
ConsoleUI (Happy Hour status, Host line, combos on menu)
Getters/setters are listed in short form; toString() is omitted.
